topics.name: Paywall and loss of free access
topics.description: Users complain that the app has moved from free to paid, with workouts now behind a paywall, limiting free usage.
topics.uncertainty: High confidence as multiple reviews explicitly mention paywall and loss of free access.

topics.name: Subscription and billing issues
topics.description: Users report unexpected charges, misleading subscription terms, difficulty canceling, and poor customer support regarding billing.
topics.uncertainty: Moderate confidence; some reviews mention billing issues but not all are explicit about subscription details.

topics.name: AI-generated content and quality decline
topics.description: Users express disappointment with the increased use of AI-generated workouts and avatars, and a perceived decline in app quality.
topics.uncertainty: Moderate confidence; some reviews mention AI and quality decline, but not all are explicit.

topics.name: Ads and redirects
topics.description: Users complain about intrusive ads, difficulty exiting ads, and unexpected redirects to external websites.
topics.uncertainty: Moderate confidence; only a few reviews mention ads, but they are clear about the issue.

topics.name: Workout customization and plan issues
topics.description: Users report that the app does not properly tailor workouts to their preferences or injuries, and that plan settings reset unexpectedly.
topics.uncertainty: Moderate confidence; some reviews mention customization issues, but not all are explicit.

topics.name: Body image and marketing concerns
topics.description: Users criticize the app for objectifying women's bodies and using unrealistic imagery in marketing and onboarding.
topics.uncertainty: Moderate confidence; only two reviews mention this, but they are detailed.
